audience: Mexican businesses that issue CFDI invoices with Facturapi

useCases.title: Find invoices and their totals
useCases.text: Filter invoices by date range, customer or payment status. Open one invoice for its SAT UUID, items and totals.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and its tax details
useCases.text: Search or list customers. Open one customer for its RFC, tax system and address.

useCases.title: Find the catalog keys for a product
useCases.text: Search the SAT product and service key catalog and the unit key catalog. List the products you already have before adding one.

useCases.title: Get the PDF or XML file of an invoice
useCases.text: Get a temporary download link for an invoice as PDF or XML. Open the invoice for its status and cancellation state.

useCases.title: Review e-receipts before invoicing them
useCases.text: List e-receipts by date range or customer. Open one receipt for its items, total and whether it was invoiced.

useCases.title: Create a customer and a draft invoice
useCases.text: Create a customer record. Then create a draft invoice for that customer. A draft is not stamped and not sent to the SAT.
